title: Regenerate MEASURED_TEST_COST_MS from the census instead of by hand
body: scripts/ci-test-groups.ts shards CI from a 23-entry cost table sampled once on 2026-07-27; docs/test_duration_census.md found it wrong in both directions two months later. Emit the table from npm run test:census output and assert in tests/unit/test_lanes.test.ts that every entry names a file that still exists. From docs/REPO_AUDIT_2026-09.md finding 2.
